title: Bad Trips Guide, Round 5
intro: Round 4's answers are in: W-CBD2 and the four APP cards are in the guide, and the checklist is out now that the app shows version 9. The three things only the checklist had (its stroke warning signs link, the Chantress Seba line with your music page, and your love page link) moved into the long part.

This page asks for your help with one paragraph. You asked me to make the CBD paragraph pass Pangram, and four versions of it all read AI: three of mine and one by GPT, on your laptop. Your own version is what has worked when that happens.

suggestions.reading: Pangram on the section with this paragraph in: [AI Generated, 100%](https://www.pangram.com/history/4a1f3bb6-6bd3-481b-94c1-477de1ea3c8e), every window AI (High, Medium, High). suggestions.why: Every version keeps reading AI, in every window. Three fresh readers (Codex, Sonnet, Haiku) say why: it's built like a balanced mini-review, every finding followed by its caveat, the sentences all the same length, and it ends on a tidy verdict ([their notes](https://github.com/u-dont-existDOTcom/joel-articles/blob/claude/bad-trips-20261103/articles/bad-trips/humanize/h02-cbd/panel-C2/PANEL.md)). Even your opening sentence, "I would also use topical magnesium chloride ...", reads AI (Medium or Low) in every version. The human things they saw in my second version were small: "people taking a lot of it", "got into the blood", "still did no better", and "I wouldn't wait on it while a seizure keeps going". What it has to keep: purified oral CBD approved for Lennox-Gastaut, Dravet and tuberous sclerosis complex; for other focal seizures the evidence going both ways; the 12-week trial (a CBD skin gel reached the blood like oral CBD but did no better than placebo); the 2025 study (high-dose oral CBD, around 23 mg/kg a day, about 1,400 mg for a 60 kg adult, focal seizures down by half to three quarters over nearly three years, no placebo group); none of it tested as a fast rescue; DMSO's rat studies; and your judgment that DMSO is an experimental extra you wouldn't wait on during a seizure. GPT's version had the weakest AI windows, if you want a start: it put your DMSO judgment first and split the approval in two ([its text](https://github.com/u-dont-existDOTcom/joel-articles/blob/claude/bad-trips-20261103/articles/bad-trips/humanize/h02-cbd/C4-codex.txt)).
suggestions.advice_note: Edit it: say it your way, keeping those points (the links go back on the study names). Or Keep it as it is, if you'd rather leave this one AI for now.
